description: Points de distribution d'eau en cas de crise à Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Localisation des points de distribution d'eau en cas de crise à Nantes Métropole Ce jeu de données permet l'identification de plateformes de distribution d'eau potable dans le cadre des PCS (Plans Communaux de Sauvegarde) déclenchés par les mairies en cas de pénurie en eau potable. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are eau, distribution, crise. The portal shows 94 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
